title: Education Funding Gap Calculator
description: Education funding arithmetic over caller-declared inputs: the future value of a declared current balance grown at a declared annual return over a declared horizon, and the funding gap against a declared goal, with a GAP_COMPUTED or GOAL_MET verdict and a full trace. On the overfunded path the page echoes a declared rollover cap in the trace note; the cap is your declaration, never a determination that any rollover is available or advisable. Absent or invalid inputs fail closed and are named. Rounding is 2dp half-up. Arithmetic only: not financial advice. No network, no storage, no clock.

goal.description: Declared funding goal in currency units, number in (0, 1000000000].

years.description: Declared horizon in years, integer in [1, 100].

annual_return_pct.description: Declared assumed annual return, percent, number in [-10, 30].

current_balance.description: Declared current saved balance in currency units, number in [0, 1000000000].

rollover_cap.description: Optional declared lifetime rollover cap in currency units, number in [0, 1000000000]; echoed in the overfunded trace note on the GOAL_MET path.
